name: Denis Gruszkiewicz
role: Junior Software AI Engineer | Python, LLM workflows and automation
summary: Student of Robotics and Process Automation (PWr) and IT systems (WSB Merito), with over a year in hospital IT support. I build LLM-based automations on my own: JobHunter combines n8n workflows, schema-validated LLM output, browser automation and a human review step; LabFlow adds a streaming local LLM chat and speech-to-text. Python is my main language.

projects.name: JobHunter
projects.stack: Node.js, n8n, PostgreSQL, Playwright, React, Ollama, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions

Playwright browser service, PostgreSQL state, Docker Compose; CI runs frontend, backend and Chromium regression tests. Status partial: no unattended submissions.

Local LLM chat with Ollama (streaming) and Polish speech-to-text with faster-whisper; both optional. Backend and Vitest tests.
